title: Wheat Berry, Butternut and Raisin Salad
subtitle: with caramelised onion and Swiss chard
description: A hearty grain salad of wheat berries, roasted butternut pumpkin, caramelised onions, Swiss chard and raisins.

steps.text: Heat a little olive oil in a pan and fry the chopped onions and finely chopped chard stalks over low heat, stirring, for 20 to 25 minutes, until the onion caramelises and turns amber.
Bring the wheat berries to the boil in a covered pot with plenty of water. Add 1 tbsp salt, reduce the heat and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, until tender. Drain and set aside.

Meanwhile, spread the peeled and 2 cm diced pumpkin in a single layer on a tray, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and bake for about 20 minutes until browned. Cool to room temperature.
Combine the wheat, caramelised onion and stalks, chopped chard leaves, pumpkin, raisins and finely chopped parsley in a large bowl. Season with olive oil, salt and pepper, mix and serve.
